plugin.name: ForgottenCity_DelayedStart.esp
plugin.description:
The courier with Cassia's letter now waits until you are level 25 (The Forgotten City's default is level 5).
Change the level at any time from the console: set FCDS_CourierLevel to 30
Only the courier is delayed. You can still find the Forgotten Ruins on your own at any level.
Needs ForgottenCity.esp (The Forgotten City 1.8). Load this patch after it. Remove the old "Forgotten City - Delayed Start.esp" (Nexus 56958) if you have it installed.
Works alongside The Forgotten City Entrance Extended, Music Bug Fixer and Good Ending Tweaks; none of them edits the record this patch changes.
ESL-flagged, so it uses no plugin slot. Install it before the courier has already been sent (before level 5 on a new character); a save where the letter is already on its way will still get it.
